title: Awesome Node.js projects catalog
description: Editor-support schema for data/projects.json. The enforcing implementation of these rules is src/validate.mjs (see npm run validate); this file exists for autocomplete and inline documentation in editors that read JSON Schema.

$schema.description: Relative path to this schema; enables editor validation.

schemaVersion.description: Bump when the shape below changes incompatibly.

categories.description: Top-level sections. Order here is the order rendered into README.md.

id.description: Lowercase, dash-separated. Also the value used as `category` on an entry.

title.description: Human heading text. Must start with a capital letter.

children.description: Optional sub-sections, rendered as a bold sub-heading.

category.description: Must match a leaf category id (a top-level id, or a child id). See npm run validate.

repo.description: Required source repository. https only; host must be github.com, gitlab.com, bitbucket.org or codeberg.org. Must be unique across the catalog.

description.description: One sentence. Must start with a capital letter, end with a full stop, and must not restate 'Node.js' (the rules are in CONTRIBUTING.md).
